citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:30am-12:00pm
on 9/2/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the doors of buildings on the property and
left a voicemail with the phone number on file. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection
is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement
action.
End Section

2.126(b) 
   
Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries. 
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:30am-12:00pm 
on 9/2/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the doors of buildings on the property and 
left a voicemail with the phone number on file. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection 
is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement 
action. 
 
 
End Section
